name: InterContinental Resort Bali
insider_take: This clifftop sanctuary in Jimbaran Bay offers front-row seats to Bali's most spectacular sunsets, where traditional Balinese architecture meets world-class luxury.
whats_special: Built into dramatic limestone cliffs 35 meters above the Indian Ocean, this resort features authentic Balinese village-style architecture with traditional alang-alang thatched roofs. The property sits on sacred grounds - the clifftop location was once home to ancient Balinese temples, and you can still visit the resort's own Pura Segara temple overlooking the ocean.
pro_tip: Book the Sunset Cliff Bar & Grill for dinner - it's perched 35 meters above sea level and offers unobstructed sunset views. Arrive 30 minutes before sunset for the best table positioning and complimentary canapés.
dont_miss: The resort's private beach club accessible via inclinator (cliff railway), and the signature Spa Uluwatu treatment featuring traditional Balinese healing rituals in clifftop pavilions. Jimbaran's famous seafood warungs are just a 10-minute walk away, where fishermen bring their daily catch directly to beachfront grills.
pros: Stunning beachfront location with direct access to pristine sandy beaches
Expansive tropical gardens and lagoon-style pools creating a serene atmosphere
Exceptional spa facilities with traditional Balinese treatments
Multiple dining venues featuring international and authentic Indonesian cuisine
cons: Large resort property requiring walking distances between facilities
Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning and beachfront location
